title: Bull kelp canopy, California's north coast

source.name: Aerial bull kelp canopy surveys, North Coast
source.publisher: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

notes: Aerial surveys found a 96% loss of kelp canopy across California's north coast following the 2013 sea-star wasting outbreak and the 2014-2016 marine heatwave, as unchecked purple urchins grazed the forests down to 'urchin barrens.' Shown as percent of pre-2014 canopy remaining.
